decisions.decision: 60-day channel gate: 20d AND 60d channels must both show upward slope + close in bottom 50% of 60d channel
decisions.rationale: 20d alone fires on breakout anomalies where lower band has no historical support below it

decisions.decision: Negative channel proximity (below lower band) = 0 pts and fails gate
decisions.rationale: Stock below its own channel is breaking down, not at support — was inflating scores to 100+ without cap

decisions.decision: Score breakdown returned from backend with per-component pts + justification text
decisions.rationale: Frontend approximation was producing impossible values like 89/25 due to uncapped channel formula

decisions.decision: Tradier sandbox before paying $10/mo live account
decisions.rationale: Validate that options data improves (more complete candidates) before committing

decisions.decision: RSI slope: current 2-point method is noisy; 5-bar linear regression planned
decisions.rationale: A single strong day makes slope look great even if RSI trend is flat

decisions.decision: Above 50 MA + at channel lower band = valid bull put spread setup
decisions.rationale: Above 50 MA = trend intact; near channel support = pullback entry before next leg up. User confirmed understanding.
